seed_data.title: PROPOWAX™ Antioxidant Shampoo 300ml
seed_data.description:
PROPOWAX™ SERIES
ANTIOXIDANT • ANTIPOLLUTION

100% Clean, Sustainable, Cruelty-free Beauty
10.1 fl. oz. / 300 ml

The PROPOWAX™ Antioxidant Shampoo is the world’s first honeycomb shampoo powered by the patented Living Honeycomb — clinically proven to deliver the highest antioxidant activity worldwide. Detoxifies and restores scalp & hair from pollution, UV, styling tools, and harsh products. Rebalances, soothes, and strengthens hair from the roots. Leaves hair radiant, nourished, and infused with a luxurious fine fragrance.

PROPOWAX™ SERIES
ANTIOXIDANT • ANTIPOLLUTION

10.1 fl. oz. / 300 ml

The PROPOWAX™ Antioxidant Shampoo is the world’s first honeycomb shampoo powered by the patented Living Honeycomb — clinically proven to deliver the highest antioxidant activity worldwide. Detoxifies and restores scalp & hair from pollution, UV, styling tools, and harsh products. Rebalances, soothes, and strengthens hair from the roots. Leaves hair radiant, nourished, and infused with a luxurious fine fragrance.

How to Use: Apply a small amount to the scalp and massage gently until it lathers. Healthy hair starts with a healthy scalp, so take your time. Rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water (avoid hot water as it weakens roots and dries hair). For best results, follow with Antioxidant Conditioner PROPOWAX™ Series.

Ingredients and Safety: Aqua (Water), Ammonium Lauryl Sulfate, Disodium Laureth Sulfosuccinate, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Sodium Lauroyl Sarcosinate, Polysorbate-20, PEG-120 Methyl Glucose Dioleate, Parfum (Fragrance), Glycerin, Honey/mel, Melissa Officinalis Flower Extract, Disodium EDTA, Glyceryl Oleate, Coco Glucoside, Lactic acid, Starch hydroxypropyltrimonium chloride, Sodium Lactate, Sodium Benzoate, Potassium Sorbate, Phenoxyethanol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Caramel, Hexyl Cinnamal.

pdp_details_sections.heading: Golden Ingredients
pdp_details_sections.body:
Patented PROPOWAX™ LIVING HONEYCOMB
Powerful Antioxidant Activity

A revolutionary technology where a real honeycomb capsule is placed in every bottle. It continuously releases antioxidants during use, repairing oxidative damage and protecting against pollution, UV, and stress. It restores scalp balance and strengthens hair at its roots.

ORGANIC HONEY
Seals in moisture

Rich in amino acids, vitamins, and minerals, it deeply hydrates and seals moisture, smoothing the hair cuticle to reduce breakage and add shine. Honey is nature’s silk — leaving hair soft, supple, and luminous.

ORGANIC BEE PROPOLIS
Ensures proper scalp hygiene

A natural shield with antiviral, antibacterial, and anti-inflammatory powers. It ensures scalp hygiene, regulates sebum, calms irritation, and prevents hair from becoming greasy too quickly.

MELISSA HYDROSOL
Purifying and soothing

A refreshing botanical water that purifies and balances the scalp. Known as “the calming herb”, Melissa gently eliminates excess sebum while protecting the natural scalp microbiome, leaving hair light, clean, and fresh.

VIEW INCI LIST

pdp_details_sections.heading: FAQ
pdp_details_sections.body:
Is it free of SLS/SLES, Parabens, Silicones?

YES. Apiceuticals Clean Beauty excludes over 2,000 harmful ingredients. Strictly dermatologically tested with 0% irritation cases.

Is the honeycomb inside real?

Yes – the patented PROPOWAX™ Living Honeycomb is real. It continuously infuses antioxidants into the shampoo, scalp, and hair..

Why are antioxidants important for haircare?

Pollution, UV, and styling create free radicals that damage scalp cells and weaken hair. Antioxidants neutralize this damage, preserving scalp health and giving hair strength, resilience, and shine.

Is it suitable for oily, dry, colored, or fine hair?

Yes – due to its adaptogenic antioxidant activity, the shampoo adjusts to each need: balancing excess sebum, hydrating dryness, protecting color-treated strands, and adding strength and volume to fine or thinning hair.

How does it smell?

WOODS OF ARCADIA
Apiceuticals' Signature Scent

– an ultra-luxury, fine fragrance created for haute perfumery.

Experience a true utopia of bliss with a spicy base from vanilla and sandalwood, rising through a sensual heart of cedarwood and blackberry, and finishing with heavenly top notes of citrus and pink pepper.

This is “Woods of Arcadia” – soft, golden, and quietly powerful – an olfactory signature of elegance, nature, and timeless luxury.

Fragrance Key Pyramid Notes:
Top: Citrus Notes, Pink Pepper, Cardamom
Middle: Apricot, Blackberry, Cedarwood
Base: Vanilla, Sandalwood, Patchouli, Agarwood
